articles.title: Saudi Arabia turns to Syria for help as fighting with Houthis escalates
articles.description: Syria is preparing to send fighters to Saudi Arabia to support its escalating conflict with rebels in neighboring Yemen. A regional official and two Syrian officials say Syrian military advisers are already in Saudi Arabia, but that no fighters have been deployed to Yemen. The officials spoke on condition of anonymity because they were not authorized to comment publicly. Fighting intensified this summer in Yemen between Iranian-backed Houthis and Saudi-backed government forces. Syria has a supply of battle-hardened fighters from its civil war, and the postwar Syrian government is closely aligned with Riyadh. Syria is also discussing joining a joint defense agreement with Saudi Arabia, Turkey, and Pakistan.
